title: The call could not be fetched from the external system
description: data of likho.import.failed.v1; published by a connector on NATS subject likho.import.failed

source.description: Which connector: the system the call comes from, e.g. ameyo

external_id.description: The call's id in that system (the dialer's crt_object_id)

reason.description: What went wrong, for a person

code.description: not_found: no such call; no_recording: the call has no audio; unavailable: the external system did not answer; rejected: the policy excludes the call
